messages:
Diego: Heads-up — enterprise customer 'Acero' asked for a delegated admin role so their SREs can manage routing policies and per-tenant quotas without touching billing or model keys.

Ava: Do they want create/delete on routes or just edit existing ones?

Diego: They said 'manage' so likely create + edit + rollback of routing policies, but no access to key material or entitlements.

Maya: Security red flag: any role that can change routing could route traffic to cheaper/experimental model variants. We need guardrails (audit + approve flows) if they can create. :thinking:

Owen: From UX: we should avoid exposing the full policy DSL in the console. Maybe a simplified flow: create a policy from a template + advanced toggle for power users.

Ava: Agreed. Also product asks for a toggle: "require approval on create" for delegated admins. When on, creates go into a queue for tenant-admin review.

Diego: Proposed permission set (first pass):

```
role: delegated_admin
permissions:
  - routing: create,edit,rollback
  - quotas: view,adjust-within-budget
  - billing: none
  - keys: none
  - audit: view
```

Maya: "adjust-within-budget" needs enforcement at API layer. We can't rely on UI to gate that. We should include quota caps per delegated admin (e.g., max burst, max daily token).

Diego: We can add attributes to role bindings: e.g., scope: [project:123], caps: {daily_tokens: 100k, burst: 10k}. The runtime already respects per-tenant caps but not per-role caps yet.

Ava: UX question: how do we show 'caps' in the roles page so it's not overwhelming? Owen, thoughts?

Owen: Show them as bullets under the role name. If a customer has many roles, collapse into a compact list with a 'details' flyout. For create flow, show a summary card: "This delegated admin can create routes up to X tokens/day".

Maya: Also need audit hooks. All routing changes must generate an immutable audit event with old/new policy, who triggered, and whether it was auto-approved or pending. sec-bot should pick that up.

sec-bot: reminder: add time-limited API keys for delegated admin CLI usage (rotate every 30d) and require mfa for user accounts that hold this role.

Diego: Implementation plan idea:
- API: add new role type + attributes (scope, caps, require_approval boolean)
- Runtime: enforce caps and route-change gating
- Console: role management UI + create-route simplified flow + approval queue view
- Audit: emit structured events to our audit log + webhook for customers

Ava: Sounds good. Prioritization: customer has committed to pilot next week. Can we do a minimal "pilot mode"?

Diego: Minimal pilot = UI toggle to assign a pre-defined "delegated_admin" role that only shows an "edit existing routes" button (no create). No per-role caps yet, but we log changes and require owner approval for create. That reduces risk.

Maya: Acceptable if we block create in UI and enforce via API that unapproved creates are rejected. Also require owner email notification flow.

Owen: I can mock the compact role card and the approval modal by EOD tomorrow.

Diego: I'll spin up API proto: new role schema + enforcement return codes (403 if action outside caps, 202 if create submitted pending approval).

Ava: I'll coordinate with customer success to set expectations. Ticket: ENG-4921 for API + runtime, ENG-4922 for console, ENG-4923 for audit/webhook.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created branch "delegated-admin/pilot" and ran CI (3/12 checks passed, 1 flaky test failed).

Maya: Postmortem note: make sure approval queue has replay protection (no double-apply on retries).

Diego: Next steps:
- Owen: mockups by tomorrow
- Diego: API proto + PoC enforcement by Thurs
- Maya: security review PR when Diego has proto
- Ava: customer comms and pilot kickoff

Ava: Great. Tagging @Acero-contacts to confirm scope. :+1:

Diego: Thanks all — I'll post API proto link here when ready.
